messages.text: just received my bc04, security seal was broken.  was there supposed to be instructions in the box?
Read the hammer miner bc04 page

Sorry about the seal, that shouldn't arrive broken. Before anything else, can you check whether the unit itself looks untouched, screws intact, no scuffs or loose parts? Send me a photo of the seal and the box if you can.

On the paperwork: I don't want to guess what was packed, so I'm confirming what's meant to ship in the BC04 box. Setup is all online anyway, and the fastest help is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD (@nullhashrate) answers hardware.

What's your order number?
Shop····
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used the store-orders skill
Thanks. What's the email on the order? I'll pull Shop···· up with that.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Looked something up in Shopify

Got it, John, Shop···· was delivered Sunday.

No, there's no printed manual in the BC04 box. It ships with the miner, a 120W power supply and a power cord, that's all. Setup is online, and your order includes the Harlo OS diagnostics add-on, so Harlo OS at harlolabs.com is where the guide and firmware live.

The broken seal still bothers me. Does the unit power up and hash normally? If anything looks off, tell me and I'll get it looked at properly.
also, is it normal for it to start mining as soon as given an ip?
Used route to tech
I'll let Hal take this one.
why am I getting used gear...
Used the store-orders skill

You shouldn't be, and I'm not going to pretend that's acceptable, John. A sealed BC04 should arrive untouched. Yours came broken-sealed, pointed at someone else's wallet and overclocked, which reads like a unit that was run before it was packed.

Two things from me. First, the overclocking was not yours, so nothing about your warranty is affected. Second, tell me what you want here: a fresh unit sent out, or to keep this one running once it's reset.

Which way?
fresh unit.  I do not trust this one
Handed to the team · RMA approval (rma-approved tag) needed before I can create the return and the he

Understood, and I'd want the same.

I've put the replacement in front of the team now, with the seal, the wallet and the overclock all noted. They're reviewing it and will confirm shortly. Once it's cleared I set up the return myself: prepaid label, you write the reference on the box, and the fresh BC04 goes out to you.

Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here. If you step away, the answer reaches you by email.
I'm out of town until friday, so no rush to get it here...

Good to know, that helps. I'll note you're back Friday, so nothing needs doing at your end before then.

One thing: unplug the BC04 and leave it off while you're away, so it isn't hashing to that wallet in the meantime.

The team's review and the label will land in your email either way, and the box can go back whenever suits you after Friday. Anything else you want me to sort while you're out?
nope, all good
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Harlo OS diagnostics plan to the order?
I didn't....

It's on the order as a separate line, Shop····, $19.45 on top of the $249 BC04. If you didn't add it, that shouldn't be there.

Want me to put it to the team to take that line off and give you the $19.45 back? Say the word and I'll pass it over with the rest.
pls
Handed to the team · Customer says he never added the add-on; refund of that line needs a person.

Done, that's with the team alongside the replacement. They'll confirm the $19.45 with you, and it goes back to the card you paid with once they action it.

Nothing else needed from you. Stay in the chat if you can and one of them will jump in here, otherwise it reaches you by email. Enjoy the trip, John.
any update?

Nothing's moved yet, John. No approval on the RMA and no refund on the $19.45 so far.

Both are sitting with the team and they're offline now, so they pick it up tomorrow from 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email either way. The moment the return is cleared I'll have your label and the fresh BC04 sorted from my side.

Keep the unit unplugged until then.
